Catch bad requirements before coding: Kiro requirements analysis in 4 steps

Four steps to catch bad requirements before you write any code.

1. Write requirements - Start from your spec's requirements.
2. Run the analysis - Kiro checks them for contradictions and gaps.
3. Answer its questions - It streams questions into your chat.
4. Fix, then build - Resolve the conflicts before any code exists.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/analyze-requirements/
